action.mutates: creates /srv/p8test-logs (owner syslog, rsyslogd's runtime user), adds /etc/rsyslog.d/99-p8test.conf routing the tag p8test to /srv/p8test-logs/p8test.log, restarts rsyslog, sends one message with logger -t p8test

creates /srv/p8test-other (owner syslog), adds /etc/rsyslog.d/98-p8test-other.conf routing the tag p8testother to /srv/p8test-other/p8test.log, restarts rsyslog, sends one message with logger -t p8testother

outcomes.outcome: the local exception grants logs_dir, and the reloaded rsyslogd profile carries it
rsyslogd keeps running confined after the reload chain
the confined rsyslogd writes a log routed into logs_dir, while a directory outside the exception stays denied
